item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
• Check up now waits for a Cleanup scan or Security check that is already running, so two never run at once.
  • Progress and errors for Move to Trash show on the screen that started them when several are queued.

item.title: Version 0.1.0
item.description:
First public release of Tidy. It finds space you can get back, shows what uses your disk and memory, and runs a security check. Anything it removes goes to the Trash.

  • Cleans caches, logs, build output and old installers, and says why each one is safe to remove
  • Shows the largest files and folders as a size map
  • Reads memory pressure and lists the apps using the most
  • Uninstalls an app along with what it left in your Library

Needs macOS 14 or later on Apple Silicon.
